limitations: Current open geographic sources are retrospective, not certified historical 2025 boundaries.
Plant capacity allocates original aggregate offers; original weather/cost time series retained.
Mixed-cluster renewable/unsupported-fuel allocation uses raw member-bus counts, not reconstructed site capacity or zonal weather.
Original hourly parent demand is allocated by preclustered source demand; unresolved pre-simplification demand splits use member counts, not independently audited observed zonal load.
Fixed reservoir schedule split by plant capacity; original pooled water allocation and exact aggregate chronology retained.
Boundary-preserving grid is rebuilt before stub removal, so topology/ratings differ from frozen 128-bus checkpoint; original uniform security factor retained.
Model-derived N-0 limits are not JAO commercial domains. Offshore shore connection and source simplification remain proxies.
Newly separate areas retain the existing EUR10,000 emergency bid, disclosed separately from real capacity.
